verdict.rationale: Automatic model routing is a fair question for an AI coding-agent platform like Codegen, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes model selection, per-prompt routing, or choosing the most suitable underlying model. The docs cover agent runs, integrations, permissions, sandboxes and wrapping Claude Code, none of which is routing.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have each task prompt automatically routed to the most suitable underlying model
